newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse to launch index in September.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse to launch index in September.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Tuesday it would launch a long-awaited official share index next month to reflect trading trends and help investors with their market decisions.
"Romania's equities market has grown and can now have a relevant index for investors," bourse general manager Stere Farmache told Reuters.

An exchange statement said the new index, called 'Bucharest Exchange Trading -- BET' and expected to be issued early in September, would consist of the market's 10 most liquid stocks and would be capitalisation-weighted.
The Bucharest stock exchange now trades 54 companies.
Farmache said the index would be comprised of the nine stocks on the bourse's current first tier plus another company expected to join that section later this month or early in September.
The blue-chip index will use January 1997 as the starting point and have a 1,000-point base.

The first tier, where listing criteria are tougher, currently consists of two pharmaceuticals companies, a refrigerator maker, four chemical plants, a vehicle parts manufacturer and a stainless steel maker.
The newcomer in the top section will be local car maker Dacia, Farmache said.
"The bourse didn't come up with an index until now as it had thought such an indicator irrelevant for a market that wasn't too liquid," he said.
The 10-stock basket will be periodically adjusted as more companies qualify for it, Farmache added.
Several brokerage houses, including Creditanstalt Securities, Vanguard and Bucharest Investment Group, worked out their own indices for the market.
